items.signal_prefix: Q2'26 consolidated results: net revenue NT$11,141.6 million

set.signal: Q2'26 consolidated results: net revenue NT$11,141.6 million, up 9.3% QoQ and 33.2% YoY; gross margin 39.5% (39.7% in Q1'26, 35.5% in Q2'25); operating profit margin 25.4%; profit attributable to the company NT$2,491.6 million; diluted EPS NT$2.04; EBITDA margin 50.0%. 2026H1 excluding revenue of the ex-subsidiary in China: net revenue NT$21,333.6 million vs NT$15,677.4 million in 2025H1, up 36.1% (the deck's column is headed HoH but compares 2026H1 with 2025H1), gross margin 39.6% (2025H1: 34.6%).

items.reason: The deck's 'HoH' column compares 2026H1 with 2025H1 (not with 2H25); the entry's bare 'up 36.1% HoH' reads as half-over-half, so the comparison base is made explicit from the same table.
